title: Depends on and Unlocks in each record
goal: Each record in the generated ledger shows its prerequisites and direct dependents in one generated line next to its summary
acceptance: work-items renders `**Depends on:** … · **Unlocks:** …` with links that resolve from the ledger (active, archived, external), only when the record has either
The authored `Depends on` row in details stays the source; Unlocks is derived
Only when tools/backlog-dependencies.mjs is present; loaded lazily
check:backlog and the queue still parse the record
validation: Fixtures: active, archived and external prerequisites, reverse links, no line without links
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Released in v5.5.0 after PR #120 (CI) and review-fix PR #121 (CI 43077690845) with independent review; baseline 1 focused day(s). No actual recorded per step: the steps were built together; the whole feature took about 1.5 agent hours including review.
